name: Ananya Banerjee
card: Ananya Banerjee is a thirty-two-year-old graphic designer in Kolkata who found the marketplace on her own over two years ago and shops on her Android phone. A gold member, she has a large stash of loyalty points that expire very soon. She has placed only one order in the last six months, a while back, and returned an item. Lately she visits a few times a month, browsing beauty, electronics, fashion and kitchen gadgets like air fryers and lipstick, without leaving carts. She has received many offers, claimed four and used one.
